note: First-slice aircraft catalogue capture. The Su-57's prototypes were the T-50 series of the PAK FA programme (wikipedia_su57_t50), so the entry answers to those designations. Note the KAI T-50 Golden Eagle is a different aircraft and is not held here. The Su-25 designation is owned by the identity-only su25_family entry and is not an alias of the Su-25 mark: a family word must never be one mark's alias, or a query that names the family answers one member of it.

empty_weight_kg.locator: Su-25 Grach (Frogfoot) record, Dimensions, Weight, Empty: 9,500 kg
empty_weight_kg.state: ODIN Worldwide Equipment Guide 2025 empty weight, stated in kilograms by the guide. It replaces the held OPFOR guide figure of 9,525 lb converted to 4,320 kg, which is a factor of two from every other published Su-25 empty weight. Both figures are kept in data/aircraft/conflicts.json.
